# AI Developer Cards

> AI Developer Cards is a physical card deck and companion app with 45+ methods across 9 quests for AI-assisted software development. Created by Ingo Eichhorst and Ralf D. Mueller from insights gathered across 100+ developer workshops in Europe.

## About
AI Developer Cards teaches modern software engineers how to build, modernize, and ship software using AI coding agents, prompt engineering patterns, and structured development methodologies. Developed from insights gathered across 100+ developer workshops. The deck covers methodologies from vibe prototyping and prompt engineering to multi-agent coding and AI software hardening.

## Key Facts
- 45+ method cards covering AI-assisted software development techniques
- 9 quest cards providing a structured learning progression
- 5 methods per quest, from beginner to advanced AI coding workflows
- Insights distilled from 100+ developer workshops across Europe
- Physical card deck in premium oversized format + companion app
- Companion app includes tutorial videos, learning games, extended prompts, and skill assessments
- Pre-launch; waitlist members receive 48-hour early access before public announcement
- Educational category: Software Development / AI-Assisted Engineering

## Topics Covered
- Vibe Prototyping: Rapid AI-assisted prototyping methods — go from napkin sketch to working demo before the meeting ends
- Greenfield MVP: Structured AI-first project setup — ship a real product, not a toy; structure, tests, and architecture from day one
- AI-Enabled Systems: LLMs as first-class software components — build software that treats LLMs as first-class components, not bolted-on afterthoughts
- Production Grade: Hardening AI-generated code for production — make it survive real users, real traffic, and real attacks
- Legacy Modernization: AI-assisted strangler pattern for legacy systems — modernize legacy systems safely with zero downtime, zero rewrites
- Agentic Coding: Single AI agent orchestration — stop typing, start directing; hand the keyboard to an AI agent and orchestrate the output
- Multi-Agent Coding: Parallel AI agent workflows — one agent is fast; multiple agents in parallel are a force multiplier
- Reinforcement Loop: Compounding AI context across sessions — every session makes the next one better; compound your AI's knowledge of your codebase
- AI Software Hardening: Compliance and quality gates for AI code — ship AI-generated code you'd bet your SLA on

## FAQ

**Q: I already use AI coding tools every day — what am I actually missing?**
A: Most developers have mastered the basics: autocomplete, Q&A, simple refactoring. What breaks down is knowing which method to reach for at each stage — when to vibe-prototype vs. harden production code, how to engineer context for consistent results, how to chain methods across a full workflow. AI Developer Cards map 45+ methods across 9 progression stages, distilled from 100+ workshops, so you always know the right move — not just the right prompt.

**Q: What did running 100+ developer workshops reveal?**
A: A consistent pattern: developers kept reinventing the same mental models from scratch. After 100+ AI coding workshops across Europe, Ingo Eichhorst and Ralf D. Mueller noticed that the gap wasn't in AI capability — it was in structured methodology. Most teams got stuck cycling between basic autocomplete and ad-hoc prompting with no clear progression. That insight became the blueprint for the 9 quests and 45+ methods in the deck.

**Q: What AI coding methods do the cards cover?**
A: The deck covers 45+ methods across 9 quests: vibe prototyping, greenfield MVP development, AI-enabled systems, production hardening, legacy modernization, agentic coding, multi-agent coding, reinforcement loops, and AI software hardening. Each method card includes specific prompts, patterns, and mental models for applying AI tools in real development scenarios.

**Q: Who are AI Developer Cards for?**
A: AI Developer Cards are designed for software engineers and developers who want to use AI tools effectively across the full software development lifecycle — from rapid prototyping to production hardening. They are especially useful for developers attending AI coding workshops, team leads introducing AI practices to their teams, and self-learners who want structured guidance beyond basic code completion.

**Q: What is included in the card deck?**
A: The physical card deck includes 9 quest cards and 45+ method cards in a premium oversized format. It comes with access to the companion app, which provides tutorial videos, learning games, extended prompts, and skill assessments to amplify every card.

**Q: When will AI Developer Cards be available?**
A: AI Developer Cards are currently in pre-launch. Waitlist members receive 48-hour early access before any public announcement. Sign up at https://aidevelopercards.com/ for early-bird pricing on the physical deck, beta access to the companion app, and an exclusive preview PDF.
